title: A Remarkable Scavenger Hunt: Around Downtown Minneapolis
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
Digital Copies of your adventure hunt photos
Photo challenges for each player - choose between Braniac, Photographer, Mapper
Let's Roam App access for maps, photo challenges, riddles and leaderboards
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Weather Check: Check the weather forecast for the day of your hunt and dress appropriately. Comfortable shoes and weather appropriate attire are recommended
Please note that this is a self-guided private tour so you can start at any time and at your own pace
Fully Charged Devices: Make sure your smartphone is fully charged before the tour as you’ll be using it to navigate and interact with the app. Please bring a power bank if you need it.
Booking Confirmation: Confirmation will be received at time of booking along with instructions on downloading the app and starting your adventure
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Let’s Roam takes the crown as the top app-led Adventure Hunt company! Wander through city streets, uncovering the finest landmarks and secret gems while tackling trivia and mastering challenges. Whether you're collaborating with your crew or engaging in friendly competition, you’ll absorb fascinating facts and forge unforgettable memories. 

Let’s Roam Adventure Hunts are perfect for everyday escapades or special occasions like bachelorette parties, birthdays, corporate team-building events, and beyond! Each participant selects an interactive role, with unique challenges tailored to every adventurer. Join the fun and embark on your next epic adventure with Let’s Roam!
